text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer, the rebel of the Mejiros. 
Though she fled from the family, she 
forged a running style true to herself and 
arrived at the stage of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Mejiro Palmer and her besties will 
show off a very different kind of Mejiro 
story.
